name: @sos-2/real-github
description: SOS 2.0 Real GitHub Adapter (Work Order P17-B): the vendor-backed realization of the frozen @sos-2/github GitHubPort contract over the REAL GitHub REST API, attached through the injectable GitHubRequestPort HTTP seam (the exact attachment P4 designed). Repository discovery, branch/revision selection, empty-repository detection (real branches probe), snapshot/metadata import, webhook registration, branch creation, commit operations (Git Data API single-commit path; contents-API initial commit on an empty repository) and PR operations are REAL API calls. Honest provider states (CONNECTED/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED) come from REAL probes only: CONNECTED requires the PAT-backed real handshake (verifyToken probes GET /user); the OAuth app authorization surface is implemented while live operation is PAT-backed (recorded honestly); GitHub rate limits surface as DEGRADED with REAL reset epochs, never as fake successes. Credentials are env-only (the value injected at the composition boundary; outcomes, notes, telemetry and evidence carry env NAMES only — never values). Deterministic reference-mode: the provider logic runs offline against a scripted request port (no hidden clocks, no ambient process.env); network happens only in the env-gated integration suite (RUN_REAL=1). ZERO external dependencies: ZERO dependencies (the P4 github package is a frozen zero-dependency no-build package — its contract surface is carried STRUCTURALLY (github-vocabulary.ts, the P8 body-runtimes precedent) and the field-for-field alignment with the real P4 sources is pinned by test in tests/real-github).
